name: MC75 Armored Cruiser
description: The MC75 Armored Cruiser, a variant of the MC75 Star Cruiser, was operated by the Rebel Alliance Navy. The Star Cruiser had a bulbous hull, a dorsal mast, a longer ventral mast, and at least four engines at the stern. At one point, an MC75 Armored Cruiser in Alliance service was present above a teal astronomical object.
